name: Simulated front mount for the D1 paired terrain sensor
intervention: Only slide the identical pair of apertures and their housings in body X, 0.355 to 0.425 m. Body Y is +0.190 and -0.190 m and Z is +0.055 m. Both arms use the same new fixed support, same axes, scanner pattern, shutter, delivery time and readouts. The 0.050 m overhang beyond the nominal nose is a proposed bracket dimension.
vehicle_frame: base_link, x forward, y left, z up. Ray directions use forward-left-up scanner coordinates, with positive depression aimed down.
fixture: The complete 30 mm narrow one-sided box of #101, both left/right mirrors, plus flat. Preserve #100 beam directions, range gate, angular mask and the 0.35 m wheel-path preview.

design.comparison: Compare the same 32 ideal source-target segments per arm. Reproduce all old classifications then count formerly four-way-blocked rows with at least one clear line. Tangent does not establish visibility. Report angular/range coverage separately. The true box and query are diagnostic inputs.

installation_gate: Check mirrored site frames attached to base, rigid FK and connected common support. At every pose in the three independent prefixes from boundary zero to 152 inclusive, require positive conservative clearance to moving visual and contact geometry in both arms. Both wheel envelopes must remain before the obstacle. A hold here is an engineering/planning result only.
visibility_gate: At least one of the six previously four-way-blocked design cases opens a clear ideal line with the proposed mount.

validation.roster: All full-body mixed flat evaluation trajectories with these three different recorded resets, 300 native decisions each. No external source has the full recorded IMU sequence. Both optical arms use the identical reference capture/delivery transform. No policy receives any oracle inputs.

readout: Primary is #105 single-packet local support, inclusive 10 mm threshold and correct side. Unknown fails. Also report #100 nearest-return readout as secondary with no rescue or substitution. Compare two paired arms on all clear and masked views; also report support of the correct rear-side ground at exits. Truth is joined after writing readings.
optical_gate: For EACH source, masked exits cannot lose correct readings, clear all-arrival failures cannot increase, and masked numeric false positives on physically flat queries cannot increase. Across all sources, at least one additional masked exit must be correct. Report masked all-arrival outcomes, raised errors, wrong fills, newly unknown and bracket hits even on failure. The results qualify only the simulated optical mounting decision at logged precontact poses.
